BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to shoreline management; creating a new section;and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Consistent with RCW 43.01.036, thedepartment of ecology must submit a report to the appropriate standingcommittees of the senate and house of representatives by September 1,2012, that includes: A summary of and update on its ongoing actionsunder the shoreline management act, chapter 90.58 RCW; significantdevelopments and issues regarding local shoreline master programs; andrelevant legislative recommendations, if any. (2) This section expires December 31, 2012.
